from __future__ import annotations
import os, sqlite3, tempfile, unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ as organ
from f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ_gold_test import POINTER_DDL, FakeStern

class ProvenanceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_andreas_origin_is_persisted_without_split_identity(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            db=Path(td)/"unified.db"
            with sqlite3.connect(db) as c: c.execute(POINTER_DDL)

                organ.host_admission=old

            self.assertEqual(r["origin"]["owner"],"andreas")
            with sqlite3.connect(db) as c:
                run=c.execute("SELECT source_machine_id,source_owner,source_installation_id,source_state_root_id FROM f2_chatgpt_organ_run").fetchone()

            self.assertEqual(run,("andreas-maco","andreas","inst-1","root-1"))
            self.assertEqual(msgs[0][1],"andreas")
            self.assertTrue(all(m[2:]==("andreas-maco","andreas","inst-1","root-1") for m in msgs))
            self.assertEqual(list(Path(td).glob("*.db")),[db])

if __name__=="__main__": unittest.main(verbosity=2)
''',encoding='utf-8')
